alpha_hypothesis: Prospective first-seen entity-theme event decisions may retain the positive replacement-value lead from exp-20260713-001 without its historical Google News availability bias.

gate2.entry_date_contract: A prospective decision is pending until next-session-open; it is not an executable backtester Position or signal.
gate2.target_price_contract: Explicit null by design because the observer uses a fixed-time 10-session paper outcome and cannot drive a target exit.

gate4.measurement_repair_acceptance_rule: Accept only as alpha-enabling measurement repair if the shared helper uses policy-observed first_seen_at rather than published_at for availability; the latest saved daily input emits exactly 10 unseen fresh URL decisions and 60 unique ticker legs; every event's leg notionals sum to 4000 USD; rerun appends zero duplicate decisions; no outcome settles before 10 trading sessions; run.py wiring is fail-soft; trade_enabled, orders, live ranking, sizing and exits remain unchanged; focused parity tests pass and the post-MTM baseline remains identical. accepted_alpha must remain false. Park performance evaluation until at least 75 settled prospective unique URL events across 15 decision dates and 3 themes with max theme share <=30% and complete cash/SPY/QQQ outcomes.

hypothesis: Alpha-enabling PIT repair for the entity_theme_news money hypothesis: persist a shared default-off first-seen exact-URL candidate pool so each newly observed URL becomes one next-session-open, 10-session paper event with unique mapped tickers sharing one fixed event notional; this creates prospective evidence without re-scoring frozen July outcomes or changing live trading.
new_evidence_axis: New gate shape and rows: a production-visible shared default-off candidate-pool/forward-observer persists policy-time first_seen_at per exact URL and starts append-only prospective decisions; unlike exp-20260713-001, it does not reuse published_at as availability or re-score frozen July outcomes.

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not evaluate returns, slice themes, change URL normalization, retune freshness/notional/hold days, or reuse published_at as availability while this prospective ledger is below its fixed reopen threshold.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: Reopen performance evaluation only after at least 75 settled prospective unique-URL events across at least 15 first-seen decision dates and 3 themes, max theme share <=30%, with complete cash/SPY/QQQ replacement values.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The shared helper records availability at policy observation time, freezes one exact-URL event allocation, and reuses stable decision IDs so a same-input rerun cannot duplicate evidence.

prediction.confidence_reason: Eleven persisted daily snapshots make first-seen deduplication directly testable, and the latest pre-market snapshot contains ten fresh unseen URLs; implementation risk remains in idempotent settlement and dirty run.py integration.
